region: Long Island Sound and its approaches, US Northeast
note: River mouths only. The gauges and the scale factor of each river are derived for every request from USGS NLDI and site metadata (see forcingkit.fetchers.usgs_rivers). comid is the NHDPlus outlet flowline; lon and lat place the mouth for the bbox test. include and exclude pin or rule out gauges by USGS site number.

mouths.name: Bronx
mouths.note: Enters the East River at Clason Point. The outlet is set by hand: NHDPlus routes the East River on through New York Harbor.

mouths.name: Quinnipiac
mouths.note: The outlet basin is New Haven Harbor's, so the scaled flow also stands for the Mill and West Rivers.

mouths.name: Connecticut
mouths.note: Travel time from Thompsonville to the mouth is roughly a day at high flow; set lag_hours to apply it.
